brief.text: Arsenal joined Chelsea and Tottenham in voting for extra protection while the Man City case drags on, and that's the most solid story of the morning. Every transfer story today is a rumour and there isn't a single "Here we go" among them. That covers a £100million hijack of a Chelsea target funded by selling three players, a William Saliba dilemma sparked by Manchester United's transfer decision, and Inter weighing up €30m for one of our squad, so take them with a big pinch of salt. What is confirmed is the January TV schedule, with two matches moved for the cameras, plus a familiar referee for Newcastle and the U18s taking on Chelsea.
